t_advice_summary_textbox.text: R links to R-colour gnoes and Y links to Y-colour gnomes (and their derivatives). One will give higher and find this at the start. When this diminishes to 0,1,2 swap.

vb_textbox.text: There are two types of baskets RED or YELLOWRed basket is linked to gnome colours: RED, BROWN, PINK, PURPLEYellow basket is linked to gnome colours: YELLOW, GREEN, BLUE, ORANGEAt the start you need to choose one... if the mushrooms is 0, 1 or 2 THEN SWITCH.At a time there will always be 1 colour basket providing more mushrooms so if you ever get 0, 1 or 2 SWITCH for next time. If you get lots more, STAY with the same!I didn't work out how the multiplier worked... (i.e. if it is 10 mushrooms with a 5x multiplier does this actually mean 2? Maybe see for yourself but don't jeopardise your total too much!)
